title: Worries that social media is making children lose touch with reality echo ancient Greeks’ fears about theatre
description: Concerns about the effect of social media on young minds mirror fears in ancient times around the way heightened drama affected audiences of public theatre.

title: Vaidisha in the Mahabharata-Era Geography: The Ancient Vidisha Region of Central Madhya Pradesh
description: Vaidisha, identified with the ancient Vidisha-Besnagar region of present-day Madhya Pradesh, occupied one of the most strategically important landscapes of central Bharat. Situated around the Betwa or ancient Vetravati River and close to the Vindhyan and eastern Malwa regions, it stood at a natural meeting point between northern India, the Malwa plateau, Bundelkhand and the routes leading farther south. title: Council orders Turkish firm to tear down holiday homes after trees cut down in ancient woodland
description: A mystery Turkish firm has been ordered by a council to tear down holiday homes built without planning permission in a 500-year-old English woodland. The company bought the 33-acre Jacobs Farm in Silsden for £1.05 million two years ago. A planning inspector rejected its appeal and ordered 100 trees to be planted to replace those lost during the unauthorised works. Source: Read Full Article
